research.text: I am a fourth-year doctoral student in the Department of Statistics and Data Science at UT Austin, where I am fortunate to be advised by James Scott and Purnamrita Sarkar . My research lies at the intersection of high-dimensional statistics and generative modeling. I am interested in training and inference algorithms that make sampling more efficient and controllable, through better pretraining objectives, reinforcement learning, and test-time methods such as guidance and scaling. A significant body of my work also uses generative models for amortized inference in scientific applications and develops hypothesis tests for model validation.
